item.title: Third victim of 99 Ranch Market crash in Westwood identified
item.description: All three victims killed when a car slammed into a grocery store in Westwood last week have been identified.

item.title: Authorities searching for missing 11-year-old girl with autism last seen in Lynwood
item.description: Los Angeles County sheriff's detectives are asking for the public's help in finding a missing 11-year-old girl last seen in Lynwood.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn addresses breaking leg in downhill crash at Winter Olympics; dad wants her to retire
item.description: Lindsey Vonn posted on social, addressing the scary crash she endured sustaining, "a complex tibia fracture" Sunday at the Winter Olympics, saying, "I have no regrets." Meanwhile, her dad said, he wants her to retire.

item.title: Rain returns this week. Here's when showers are expected in SoCal
item.description: A big shift in the weather pattern brings a chance of rain this week as well as more showers next week.

item.title: Thousands of dollars in puppets, props stolen from children's show creator in Hollywood Hills heist
item.description: A boxload of handmade puppets and props from a touring children's show was stolen in a mysterious heist in the Hollywood Hills overnight.

item.title: Multiple SoCal performers, businesses featured in Bad Bunny's Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: Many local stars were in Bad Bunny's halftime show, including a 5-year-old from Costa Mesa, Latin dancers from a North Hollywood studio and Highland Park's Villa's Tacos.

item.title: Gray wolf roams into north L.A. County for the first time in more than a century
item.description: A 3-year-old female gray wolf arrived in the northwestern part of Los Angeles County near Pyramid Lake Saturday morning, according to the data from her GPS collar.

item.title: Social media 'addicting the brains of children,' plaintiff's lawyer argues in landmark trial
item.description: The world's biggest social media companies face several landmark trials this year that seek to hold them responsible for harms to children who use their platforms.

item.title: 49ers DL Keion White recovering after being shot in ankle at post-Super Bowl event in SF, team says
item.description: San Francisco police say it happened on Mission Street near 14th, after an alleged altercation between two groups. They don't believe White was involved -- but he was shot in the crossfire.

item.title: Long Beach man marks 25 years of hosting 'Jeopardy!' tournaments for students while battling cancer
item.description: "Jeopardy!" superfan Jim Birge is battling pancreatic cancer, but says he is inspired by Alex Trebek to complete his 25th year hosting a tournament for Long Beach students.
